title: Notes and shorter letters
notes: round 1: question dropped, its quote is not said word for word: What does a sloppy letter proclaim about a person?

unit.title: Notes and shorter letters
unit.needIt: Good manners in writing help people trust your character and see you as organized. It shows you care enough to be clear and neat when you send a note to a neighbor or a boss.
unit.why: A messy letter with bad spelling and crooked lines tells a story about a messy mind. A neat note shows you are a person who takes pride in the small details of life.
unit.outcome: Write notes that reflect a neat and reliable character.
unit.reachesYou: You see this when you send a thank you note to a family friend or a quick message to a coworker. It is the difference between looking like a professional and looking like a mess.
unit.do: Write a short thank you note this week on a clean piece of paper. Focus on making your handwriting steady and your spelling perfect.

quiz.q: What is the highest achievement in writing notes or letters?
quiz.why: The text states that simplicity and naturalness are the highest goals.
quiz.quote: the highest achievement is in giving the appearance of simplicity, naturalness and force.

quiz.q: What should you do if it is hard to write in a straight line?
quiz.why: The text suggests using a lined guide for those who struggle with straight lines.
quiz.quote: If it is hard for you to write in a straight line, use the lined guide that comes with nearly all stationery;

quiz.q: What is the rule for choosing paper for a man?
choices: It should be odd in shape
quiz.why: The text specifies that a man's paper should always be strictly conservative.
quiz.quote: Writing paper for a man should always be strictly conservative.

quiz.q: What is the best ending to a formal social note?
quiz.why: The text lists 'Sincerely' as the best ending for a formal social note.
quiz.quote: The best ending to a formal social note is, "Sincerely," "Sincerely yours," "Very sincerely," "Very sincerely yours," "Yours always sincerely," or "Always sincerely yours."

quiz.q: What is the rule for writing a letter of condolence?
quiz.why: The text says you should say what you truly feel and nothing else.
quiz.quote: One rule, and one only, should guide you in writing such letters. Say what you truly feel. Say that and nothing else.

crystal.key: A note is a mirror that reflects your character and taste.

decoys.why: The text says this shows vainglory and ignorance.
The text says it is an offense of pretentiousness.

crystal.aha: When you write simply and neatly, you show the reader you are a person of good character.
